workspace.namePatternDescription: Enter the exact assigned Multi-AMC team workspace name.

dataHandlingRules: Do not download patient-level data, PHI, credentials, tokens, or connection strings into the Codespace.
Use synthetic, public, aggregate, or explicitly approved data.
Label Synthea and supplemental events as synthetic.
Keep published CMS ratings distinct from demonstration calculations.
additionalInstructions: Preserve shared grains, keys, provenance, CMS labels, and synthetic-data disclosures.
Publish only reviewed team outputs to the organizer-designated integration workspace.
